definitions: To divide into two or more pieces.
To separate from someone or something.
To comb hair in such a way that it separates on either side of a line.
examples: The magician will part the silk scarf.
They had to part at the airport.
He will part his hair neatly.
The crowd began to part as the car approached.
pastTenses: parted (past simple), parted (present perfect), parted (past perfect)
